classification: host-side release evidence tooling; not a server runtime payload or package-builder change
later_gate_invocations: Same script with --source-root, --release-dir, and --report for clean-source/draft/public assets.
revision_note: The candidate inventory used the verifier in its original default-path form before the post-tag CLI extension. After the tag, optional --source-root, --release-dir, and --report arguments were added so clean-source, canonical draft, and public-download inventories could be run without modifying the tagged source or placing reports in download directories. The release review confirmed the change is limited to input/output locations; archive and checksum assertions are unchanged.
